mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates aggressive monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.5% signals economic distress, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a mismatch between manufacturing output and labor market strength, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day returns as investors anticipate a weak economic rebound.
failure_condition: The joint signal of INDPRO decline and PAYEMS rise does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 260) during a monetary policy tightening cycle leads to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as central banks raise rates to combat inflation.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 260.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400 thousand units indicate weak consumer demand for durable goods, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns as the housing sector is a key component of GDP.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when HOUST is below 1400.

mechanism_narrative: A GDP level below 20000 billion and retail sales below 500000 million indicate weak aggregate demand, producing negative S&P 500 20-day returns as economic activity falters.
failure_condition: The joint condition of GDPC1 < 20000 and RSAFS < 500000 does not yield negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) signals contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% is associated with positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns due to immediate market reaction to monetary policy.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.
